svg.title: htop: tech stack
svg.desc: An htop screen on a green CRT lists the tech stack as processes. Languages: Python, C#/.NET, JavaScript (core), TypeScript, Swift, Java, Bash, SQL. Backend: FastAPI, Flask/Flask-RESTX, .NET Web API/Core (core), Node/Express, Django. Frontend: React, Angular/AngularJS (core), Vue, Redux, SwiftUI. Cloud: AWS (core) Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, EventBridge, S3, Glue/Spark, EKS/ECS; Azure; Heroku. DevOps: GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins. Data: MS SQL Server, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Redshift, DynamoDB, Tableau, pandas/NumPy. Testing: PyTest (core), Playwright BDD, Vitest/RTL, XCTest, TDD. Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, CloudWatch, Azure App Insights. AI: Claude Code, MCP, Copilot, local RAG (LangChain, Ollama, ChromaDB), Tesseract OCR. Meter bars are decorative activity, not skill levels.
